title: Polkadot ($DOT) Technical Analysis – Buy or Sell Right Now?
description:
📢 Polkadot (DOT) Price Analysis & Prediction 📢

In this video, I break down the latest Polkadot (DOT) price action using BraveNewCoin and TradingView. We’ll analyze key support & resistance levels, market structure, and potential entry zones. Is now a good time to buy or should you wait for confirmation? Watch until the end to get the full analysis! #polkadot #dot #crypto #cryptocurrency 

Let me know in the comments: Are you bullish or bearish on Polkadot? Where do you see DOT’s price heading next?

asr.full_text: hey everyone welcome back to the channel today we are diving into polkadot and breaking its current market conditions before we get into the charts let's take a quick look at brave new coin to check out dot's price action market cap and latest trends dot has been on an increase in the last 24 hours by 3.6 percent if we take a look at this 24-hour chart we can see that it's climbing steadily but if we take a look at monthly chart we can see a downtrend clearly formed now we will break this technically check the overall trend then we'll look at monthly chart we can see a downtrend clearly formed. Now we will break this technically, check the overall trend, then we'll look at support and resistance levels, indicators and potential trade setups. So let's hop on trading view and see what's next. Here we have Polkadot chart on three-day time frame. We will check multiple time frames to get the most optimal entry and the level we need. Let's start by marking out support and resistance levels. If we zoom out a bit, we have a major resistance right here and a major support down here. As you can notice we are currently in the support and we have rejected from it with a WIC. Another key level would be this and we have two EMAs aligning with this level. Right now it is very risky to see what will Polkadot do on daily time frame. We have some valid order blocks These would be good for selling. We also notice that EMAs are actually inside of this zone. We have a pretty valid breaker block as well. So you have two zones to choose from if you want a short. If we pull a Fibonacci tool from the high to the low we see that price has filled 50 percent of this leg. It is very risky and not advisable to buy right now because price is in a clear downtrend. We have a break of structure with a full body candle, so right now we will be looking for shorts till price tells us otherwise. If price were to break over this high I will make an updated video, showcasing potential trade setups for longs, but for now, we should definitely consider some shorts, into this level deeper, maybe even take out all of this liquidity that's resting below these lows. So based on our analysis DOT is clearly bearish with forming lower highs and higher lows this break of structure confirmed our bearish momentum we can expect price to react from this key level right here or this key level right here we have overlapping EMA's with these levels that gives us more confidence possible targets would be our liquidity resting below these lows here And also, if we have any of the two levels overlapping, with the risk being on the low side, what you really got here with this scenario is a fairly good, positive performance with such a value, as it would be a good idea to use a similar analysis or take a stand here for a second. Thank you for watching. Stay tuned to stay tuned until next time.
